evals.name: minimal-token-system-migration
evals.prompt: The dashboard uses one-off colors, radii, shadows, and buttons. Establish a minimal design system and migrate the touched components without redesigning the product.
evals.expected_output: Token layers, semantic names, primitives/variants, full states, migration plan, and no unused variants or large component library.
assertions: Defines token layers (primitive/semantic/component) rather than a flat list
Replaces raw hex or arbitrary values in the touched components
Consolidates inconsistent buttons into variants with states
Includes focus, disabled, error, and loading states
Provides a migration path and avoids adding unused variants
Does not redesign the product or add a large component library
